Bash(cd "D:/Studieren/Psychologie/Statistik/R Projects/SimMSAR_codex" && "/c/Program Files/R/R-4.5.2/bin/Rscript.exe" - <<'EOF'
suppressPackageStartupMessages\({
  library\(dplyr\)
  library\(dunn.test\)
}\)

MSAR_dynamics_list <- readRDS\("output/MSAR_models_20260203_064851.rds"\)

# --- Part 1.1: corr_results ---
corr_results <- MSAR_dynamics_list %>%
  rename\(Timesteps = timesteps, Density = density, Nodes = nodes, Regimes = regimes\) %>%
  group_by\(Timesteps, Density, Nodes, Regimes\) %>%
  mutate\(SimID = ts_id, RegimeIndex = regime_id, N = n_distinct\(SimID\)\) %>%
  ungroup\(\) %>%
  mutate\(Condition = interaction\(Timesteps, Density, Nodes, Regimes, drop = TRUE\)\) %>%
  mutate\(SimUID = interaction\(Condition, SimID, drop = TRUE\)\) %>%
  select\(SimUID, Condition, SimID, Timesteps, Density, Nodes, Regimes, RegimeIndex, N, everything\(\)\)

corr_results <- corr_results %>%
  mutate\(
    Timesteps   = factor\(Timesteps\),
    Density     = factor\(Density\),
    Nodes       = factor\(Nodes\),
    Regimes     = factor\(Regimes\),
    RegimeIndex = factor\(RegimeIndex\)
  \)

# --- Part 1.2: failure analysis ---
aggr_factors <- corr_results %>%
  select\(Timesteps, Density, Nodes, Regimes, N\) %>%
  distinct\(\)

n_ts_per_condition <- n_distinct\(corr_results$SimID\)
n_conditions       <- nrow\(aggr_factors\)
expected_total     <- n_ts_per_condition * n_conditions
omissions          <- expected_total - sum\(aggr_factors$N\)
omissions_per      <- round\(\(omissions / expected_total\) * 100, 2\)

cat\("\\n=== SELECTION BIAS ANALYSIS ===\\n"\)
cat\(sprintf\("Conditions:                %d\\n", n_conditions\)\)
cat\(sprintf\("n_ts per condition:        %d\\n", n_ts_per_condition\)\)
cat\(sprintf\("Total expected:            %d\\n", expected_total\)\)
cat\(sprintf\("Total successful fits:     %d\\n", sum\(aggr_factors$N\)\)\)
cat\(sprintf\("Total failures:            %d \(%.2f%%\)\\n\\n", omissions, omissions_per\)\)

failure_analysis <- aggr_factors %>%
  mutate\(expected_n = n_ts_per_condition,
         failures   = expected_n - N,
         failure_rate = failures / expected_n\) %>%
  arrange\(desc\(failure_rate\)\)

has_any_failures <- any\(failure_analysis$failure_rate > 0\)

if \(has_any_failures\) {
  high_failure <- failure_analysis %>% filter\(failure_rate > 0\)
  cat\(sprintf\("Conditions with any failures: %d / %d\\n\\n", nrow\(high_failure\), n_conditions\)\)

  cat\("Failure rate distribution:\\n"\)
  print\(summary\(failure_analysis$failure_rate\)\)
  cat\("\\n"\)

  cat\("Top 15 worst conditions:\\n"\)
  print\(high_failure[1:min\(15, nrow\(high_failure\)\),
        c\("Timesteps","Density","Nodes","Regimes","N","failures","failure_rate"\)],
        n=15\)
  cat\("\\n"\)

  cat\("Failure rate by predictor level \(mean\):\\n"\)
  for \(pred in c\("Timesteps","Density","Nodes","Regimes"\)\) {
    cat\(sprintf\("  %s:\\n", pred\)\)
    tbl <- failure_analysis %>%
      group_by\(.data[[pred]]\) %>%
      summarise\(mean_fr = round\(mean\(failure_rate\),4\), .groups="drop"\) %>%
      arrange\(.data[[pred]]\)
    for \(i in seq_len\(nrow\(tbl\)\)\) {
      cat\(sprintf\("    %s = %s : %.4f\\n", pred, tbl[[pred]][i], tbl$mean_fr[i]\)\)
    }
  }
  cat\("\\n"\)
}
EOF)

Bash(cd "D:/Studieren/Psychologie/Statistik/R Projects/SimMSAR_codex" && "/c/Program Files/R/R-4.5.2/bin/Rscript.exe" - <<'EOF' 2>&1
suppressPackageStartupMessages\({
  library\(dplyr\); library\(dunn.test\); library\(lme4\); library\(lmerTest\)
}\)

MSAR_dynamics_list <- readRDS\("output/MSAR_models_20260203_064851.rds"\)

# --- Part 1.1 ---
corr_results <- MSAR_dynamics_list %>%
  rename\(Timesteps=timesteps, Density=density, Nodes=nodes, Regimes=regimes\) %>%
  group_by\(Timesteps, Density, Nodes, Regimes\) %>%
  mutate\(SimID=ts_id, RegimeIndex=regime_id, N=n_distinct\(SimID\)\) %>%
  ungroup\(\) %>%
  mutate\(Condition=interaction\(Timesteps,Density,Nodes,Regimes,drop=TRUE\),
         SimUID=interaction\(Condition,SimID,drop=TRUE\)\) %>%
  mutate\(Timesteps=factor\(Timesteps\), Density=factor\(Density\),
         Nodes=factor\(Nodes\), Regimes=factor\(Regimes\), RegimeIndex=factor\(RegimeIndex\)\)

# --- Failure analysis ---
aggr_factors <- corr_results %>% select\(Timesteps,Density,Nodes,Regimes,N\) %>% distinct\(\)
n_ts_per_condition <- n_distinct\(corr_results$SimID\)
failure_analysis <- aggr_factors %>%
  mutate\(expected_n=n_ts_per_condition, failures=expected_n-N,
         failure_rate=failures/expected_n\)
high_fail_conditions <- failure_analysis %>%
  filter\(failure_rate > 0.1\) %>%
  select\(Timesteps, Density, Nodes, Regimes\)
selection_bias_detected <- TRUE

# --- Fisher-Z ---
corr_cols <- c\("Wtemp_corr","Wtemp_ac_corr","Wcont_corr","Wcont_ac_corr"\)
eps <- 1e-6
for \(cc in corr_cols\) {
  r <- corr_results[[cc]]
  r <- pmin\(pmax\(r, -1+eps\), 1-eps\)
  corr_results[[paste0\(cc,"_z"\)]] <- atanh\(r\)
}
z_cols <- paste0\(corr_cols, "_z"\)

# --- Aggregation ---
corr_results_for_agg <- corr_results %>%
  mutate\(Timesteps_num=as.numeric\(as.character\(Timesteps\)\),
         Density_num=as.numeric\(as.character\(Density\)\),
         Nodes_num=as.numeric\(as.character\(Nodes\)\),
         Regimes_num=as.numeric\(as.character\(Regimes\)\)\)

dat_sim <- corr_results_for_agg %>%
  group_by\(SimUID, Condition, SimID, Timesteps_num, Density_num, Nodes_num, Regimes_num\) %>%
  summarise\(across\(all_of\(z_cols\), mean, .names="{.col}"\), .groups="drop"\) %>%
  rename\(Timesteps=Timesteps_num, Density=Density_num,
         Nodes=Nodes_num, Regimes_fac=Regimes_num\)

# --- Scale predictors ---
dat_sim <- dat_sim %>%
  mutate\(logT=as.numeric\(scale\(log\(Timesteps\)\)\),
         Density_s=as.numeric\(scale\(Density\)\),
         Nodes_s=as.numeric\(scale\(Nodes\)\),
         Regimes=factor\(Regimes_fac\),
         network_id=interaction\(Density,Nodes,Regimes,SimID,drop=TRUE\)\) %>%
  select\(-Regimes_fac\)

cat\("dat_sim rows:", nrow\(dat_sim\), "\\n\\n"\)

# --- Fit 2-way models \(full data\) ---
cat\("=== Fitting 2-way models on full data ===\\n\\n"\)
all_results <- list\(\)
for \(outcome in corr_cols\) {
  outcome_z <- paste0\(outcome, "_z"\)
  f <- as.formula\(paste0\(outcome_z, " ~ \(logT+Density_s+Nodes_s+Regimes\)^2 + \(1|network_id\)"\)\)
  m <- lmer\(f, data=dat_sim, REML=FALSE, control=lmerControl\(optimizer="bobyqa"\)\)
  all_results[[outcome]] <- list\(primary_model=m, random_effects_formula="\(1|network_id\)"\)
  cat\("  Fit:", outcome, if\(isSingular\(m\)\) "[SINGULAR]" else "[OK]", "\\n"\)
}

# --- Sensitivity analysis ---
cat\("\\n=== SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ===\\n\\n"\)
cat\("Excluded conditions:\\n"\)
print\(high_fail_conditions\)
cat\("\\n"\)

excl <- high_fail_conditions %>%
  mutate\(Timesteps_num=as.numeric\(as.character\(Timesteps\)\),
         Density_num=as.numeric\(as.character\(Density\)\),
         Nodes_num=as.numeric\(as.character\(Nodes\)\),
         Regimes_chr=as.character\(Regimes\)\) %>%
  select\(Timesteps_num, Density_num, Nodes_num, Regimes_chr\)

dat_sim_sens <- dat_sim %>%
  mutate\(Regimes_chr=as.character\(Regimes\)\) %>%
  anti_join\(excl, by=c\("Timesteps"="Timesteps_num","Density"="Density_num",
                        "Nodes"="Nodes_num","Regimes_chr"\)\) %>%
  select\(-Regimes_chr\)

cat\(sprintf\("Full dat_sim:  %d rows\\n", nrow\(dat_sim\)\)\)
cat\(sprintf\("After exclusion: %d rows \(-%d\)\\n\\n", nrow\(dat_sim_sens\),
            nrow\(dat_sim\)-nrow\(dat_sim_sens\)\)\)

for \(outcome in corr_cols\) {
  outcome_z  <- paste0\(outcome, "_z"\)
  f <- as.formula\(paste0\(outcome_z, " ~ \(logT+Density_s+Nodes_s+Regimes\)^2 + \(1|network_id\)"\)\)
  m_sens <- lmer\(f, data=dat_sim_sens, REML=FALSE, control=lmerControl\(optimizer="bobyqa"\)\)

  cf <- fixef\(all_results[[outcome]]$primary_model\)
  cs <- fixef\(m_sens\)

  comparison <- data.frame\(
    Predictor  = gsub\(":", " x ", names\(cf\)\),
    Full       = round\(cf, 4\),
    Sensitivity= round\(cs, 4\),
    Delta      = round\(cs - cf, 4\),
    Delta_pct  = round\(100*\(cs-cf\)/ifelse\(abs\(cf\)<1e-10, NA, cf\), 1\),
    row.names  = NULL
  \)

  cat\(sprintf\("--- %s %s ---\\n", outcome,
              if\(isSingular\(m_sens\)\) "[SINGULAR]" else "[OK]"\)\)
  print\(comparison, row.names=FALSE\)
  cat\("\\n"\)
}
EOF)
